card.name: The word of after a comma
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after a comma, as in "respectively, of patients", "trials, of which" and "Nowadays, of course". Weaker on other words after a comma, such as "back" in "backache".

modes.label: Of after trial figures
modes.description: "of" follows a comma after percentages or trial counts, before patients or "which".

modes.label: Of course after comma
modes.description: "of" opens the phrase "of course" after a comma.

modes.label: Other word after comma
modes.description: A different word follows a comma in a list or aside, such as "back" in a symptom list.
modes.example: irritability, anxiety,<< back>>ache, joint pain, weakness, abdominal
